answer: Strongest sybil defense: on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions. Fake identities are cheap, like waves in the ocean, but a verifier must stake collateral before countersigning — a bond moored at the jetty, guarding a wide reef of sybils. Auditors re-execute sampled transactions each epoch; a signature on an invalid one burns the stake, far above the epoch reward. Sybils cost nothing to spawn but everything to validate: one mistake forfeits more than years of honest fees. Attacks become capital traps, not spam.
